title: Choose the mode-specific export route
when: Before moving or deleting the universe containing strategy and work
need: Use the source mode: local and self-host sources export with --pause-source and stay paused until universe resume; ordinary backups are not hosted move receipts. Hosted Prepare archive pauses its source and binds the dump and receipt to one snapshot. Polled named phases show access checks, source pause, drain, database export, packing, upload, then ready and paused, with elapsed seconds and bytes. Download archive and Copy link share the signed result with an absolute expiry; Resume source is available while paused. Hosted Import offers a backup first and asks for explicit replacement consent. It fetches and verifies the signed source, checks the destination, and finishes as a complete replacement with the prior database gone, then shows receipt status. Undo the replacement only by importing the saved backup. Fresh machine connections and unrelated organization creation work immediately after success. Only an import in flight fences its target organization. Interrupted recovery before publication restores the original automatically; after publication it finishes cleanup and never restores the original. Refusals and recovery stay in the active dialog; an interrupted import response recovers its durable operation rather than inviting a duplicate submit. No remote database credentials are needed as a shortcut. For local or self-host archives, select the destination hosted connection and run universe upload with --org matching that connection; paste the returned signed link into Import before its printed expiry. Slow transfers refresh the same multipart upload automatically. PostgreSQL admission closes the original source to every client, including older engines, while export and paused self-host authentication read a frozen copy. The copy needs additional database space and is removed after Resume. Server/import coordination stays on a maintenance-database lock. Failed Resume refences the source; any writes accepted during the explicit attempt remain. Export and estimate keep confirmed absent bytes as artifact_source_absent and unavailable handles or owners as artifact_handle_or_owner_unavailable. Other read failures refuse with archive_artifact_unreadable and access or checkout recovery; files over the per-file limit refuse with archive_artifact_too_large. Local and self-host exports can exclude artifacts explicitly to bypass file transfer. Hosted Prepare archive has no exclusion; when it refuses with export_size_limit or export_disk_limit, prune old records with yoke universe prune --apply, then Prepare archive again. A refused paused export keeps the source paused and names universe resume. Hosted export refusal directs to Prepare archive in the dashboard Universe portability controls. Unsupported archive-format readers refuse with archive_tool_version_unsupported and instruct matching or newer PostgreSQL tools, preserving the original archive. Hosted sources resume through Resume source in the dashboard Universe portability controls. Authority comparisons exclude UI preferences, frontend rate admission, and merge-queue observation cadence; their rows and owned sequences remain protected by the archive checksum. Project content and repository bindings retain their authority checks.
surface: Universe portability export and Import dialogs; universe export and resume help; portability reference.
